title: Chat messages do not render markdown code fences
description: Live check 2026-10-11: a bot reply containing a fenced block shows the literal three backticks and the language word (```text) as plain text and the lines unformatted. Render markdown (at least fenced code blocks with monospace and a copy button, inline code, lists) in bot messages, following docs/BRAND_GUIDELINES.md.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done in PR 510: react-markdown 9.1.0 and remark-gfm 4.0.1 render fenced code (language label and a Copy button), inline code, lists, links (http, https, mailto), headings, quotes and tables; raw HTML escaped. Verified live: the UICheck reply shows a code block with a text label and Copy. Not verified: the copy button writing to the clipboard.
